fields.label: Environment
fields.description: Which HitPay environment the server calls. Sandbox uses api.sandbox.hit-pay.com.

fields.label: Business API Key
fields.description: HitPay Business API key. Stored encrypted; never sent to the device.

fields.label: Webhook Salt
fields.description: Salt used to verify the HMAC signature on inbound HitPay webhooks.

fields.label: HitPay Mode of Payment
fields.description: Mode of Payment recorded on the POS Invoice for HitPay-settled sales.

fields.label: HitPay Clearing Account
fields.description: Optional. Clearing account the HitPay payment is booked to (defaults to the Mode of Payment's account for the company).

fields.label: Default Customer
fields.description: Walk-in customer used on POS Invoices when the sale has no named customer.

fields.label: Plastic Bag Item
fields.description: Item charged per plastic bag (e.g. $0.10). Added as a line when bag_qty > 0.

fields.label: Stock Update Mode
fields.description: Realtime: each POS Invoice moves stock at sale time. End of Day: invoices skip stock; one consolidated movement is posted at day close.

fields.options: This toggle is the experiment: Realtime writes one stock-ledger batch per sale; End of Day writes one per day at close. Compare the resulting API-call / resource cost via POS Closing Entry + Checkout Session records.
